cases.title: Paced tissue
cases.line: A strip of heart muscle paced from the left edge: each beat a wave of voltage that sweeps across and recovers behind.

cases.title: Spiral wave
cases.line: A broken wave curls into a spiral that drives the tissue by itself, faster than any heartbeat: the shape of re-entrant tachycardia.

cases.title: Scroll wave in a ventricle
cases.line: The same spiral wrapped onto a ventricle's wall, where it becomes a scroll wave: the electrical engine of ventricular tachycardia.
